scope: Tighten full LLM reference templates for the existing seven Item roots, eleven Activity roots and Effects; preserve legacy parser support and module independence.
changes: Cast spell level, Summon temporary HP, Forward activation and Cast/Transform measured-template prompts are in the main templates.
Main Activity references use canonical override names, canonical Check mappings and canonical Transform CUSTOM OPTIONS; conflicting legacy toggles are removed.
Formula, decimal, nullable, typed effect-value, list and inactive-setting guidance is reconciled with current parser behavior.
Item references use canonical Consumable Magic Bonus, omit unsupported Loot Equipped and document fixed Container quantity and unsupported Tool proficiency 1.5.
Compact activity/effect examples use canonical range, duration, change-type and status-list labels.
Source-only completeness checks run automatically in the existing explicit YAML suite; they check YAML structures rather than prose mentions.
documentedAlternatives: An adjacent, parsed commented RECOVERY entry documents the optional empty list shape.
Complete named Active Effect start fields represent the object alternative to mutually exclusive Start: null.
Container quantity is fixed at one by the current builder and omitted by canonical export.
limits: Completeness covers current declared importer mappings; it does not establish support for every native field, every enum combination, or unreviewed sheet behavior.
No new Item/Activity types, parser features, third-party automation or platform upgrades.
Live tests ran with both importers and existing MIDI-QOL/DAE integrations active.
Existing native field catalog snapshots remain historical captures; current MCP queries reflect the corrected Tool proficiency mapping.
